name: Profile Research Briefs
subtitle: Structured briefs on any list of people, exportable as CSV.
summary: Researches up to 25 people (a contact list, your signal-agent leads, a dataset you already collected, or pasted handles) into structured briefs: what they do, what they're building, recent topics, hooks quoting their real posts, and an opener angle. Saved as a dataset you can download.
howToAsk: Research everyone in my [list] and give me a breakdown
provide: the list, agent, dataset, or handles; optionally a research focus.
get: briefs in chat plus a CSV/XLSX download.
chips: Big runs finish in the background
launchPrompt: Research these people into outreach briefs with hooks from their real posts, then give me the export when it is done. Use these handles: [paste @handles], or my latest signal-agent leads if I have any. Tell me the credit cost before you start.
